name: findutils

commands.command:
chown -R tester .
su tester -c "PATH=$PATH make check -k"

description: The Findutils package contains programs to find files. Programs are provided to search through all the files in a directory tree and to create, maintain, and search a database (often faster than the recursive find, but unreliable unless the database has been updated recently). Findutils also supplies the xargs program, which can be used to run a specified command on each file selected by a search.

installed_descriptions.name: find
installed_descriptions.description: Searches given directory trees for files matching the specified criteria

installed_descriptions.name: locate
installed_descriptions.description: Searches through a database of file names and reports the names that contain a given string or match a given pattern

installed_descriptions.name: updatedb
installed_descriptions.description: Updates the locate database; it scans the entire file system (including other file systems that are currently mounted, unless told not to) and puts every file name it finds into the database

installed_descriptions.name: xargs
installed_descriptions.description: Can be used to apply a given command to a list of files
